answer: Here is a specific defense: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the tide to sunk effort, uses the lotus as an corroborating signal, then requires a island before any payout.
